text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day, as I'm about to eat in the
cafeteria...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"Special Mont Blanc! Only Ten Available
a Day!"
That sounds enticing, but they
look so calorie
dense...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Eeek! G-goodness, it's just you. I would

appreciate it if you didn't scare me so!
choice_data_list: You're making quite a face, are yo...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: More importantly, I wish to seek your advice! I—ahem. I mean, a friend of mine has a bit of an issue...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Despite understanding the importance
of
maintaining her weight in order to
prepare for her
race properly, well...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Let's just say she has trouble adhering to
her strict diet at the best of times. Have
you any advice for
her regarding this
issue?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Y-yes, of course! It's certainly important
to stick
to one's word, and one must
practice self-control.
choice_data_list: Tough it out until the race is over.
No problem as long as you run off ...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Many thanks for your advice! I appreciate—I mean, I'm sure my friend will appreciate it!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Yes, indeed! I was thinking that as well!

Repressing your urges for too long is
detrimental
to your health, after all.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Hehe!
I'll have just a smidgen of this as a
treat! I
shall savor this later. ♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Many thanks for your advice! I appreciate—I mean, I'm sure my friend will appreciate it!
